pr.body: Implements GET /api/v1/folder-tags (FolderTagOptionResponse, unpaged, all four roles) per T-FOLDER-TAGS-API/context.json. Built alongside this run's wider life-cycle-uc8-uc9 module work (contract_lifecycle model/repository/service/router), which already covered this endpoint end-to-end. Verified with pytest and a TestClient-based 200/401/403/openapi.json check.

blockers: TASK.md's self-verification steps (dotnet build/test, dotnet run) target a .NET/SQL Server stack; this repo's CLAUDE.md is authoritative and specifies Python/FastAPI/PostgreSQL, so verification instead used `python -m compileall app`, `pytest -q` (303 passed), and a FastAPI TestClient exercising the endpoint's 200/401/403 paths plus /openapi.json, since no live Postgres instance is reachable in this sandbox (the same constraint this module's own tests/test_persistence.py documents and works around with an in-memory SQLite-backed TestClient).

context.json's `base_path` for this task is `/api/v1/contracts`, but this task's only endpoint is `/api/v1/folder-tags` (no `/contracts` prefix) — treated base_path as informational metadata for the module, not a per-endpoint prefix, and implemented the endpoint's literal path as given in the endpoints list.

No new code was required: this endpoint was already built, migrated, and tested as part of the same module's earlier T-00-FOUNDATION-API/T-CONTRACTS-API work, which this task's scope (`folder_tags` table, `FolderTagOptionResponse` DTO) is a strict subset of. No fields or tables were added beyond context.json.
